thesis: Narrative depth comes from moving through exact source strata and lawful representation changes, not generated connective prose.

Recovered 2021 proto-root is visible as a distinct source stratum with exact SHA-256 provenance.
AEGINOPRS recurrence is enacted visually as a mechanical rearrangement only.
Four exact 2026 source movements remain explicit source choices with unchanged story bytes.
FIELD still exposes exactly READ / RIDE / SOURCE; ROOT remains native Prison Age depth, not a fourth FIELD action.
RIDE ROOT enters the existing FOLD//BLOOM authored-reader seam and can RETURN to the exact constellation address.
2026 Prison Age RIDE source affordance now returns to /prison-age/ instead of opening an unrelated file picker.

experience_grammar: ROOT: exact recurrence inside recovered 2021 source
READ: exact addressed source through READFIELD
RIDE: exact addressed source through FOLD//BLOOM LIVE
ECHO: exact cross-source lexical evidence only
RELEASE: mutates LIVE field state, never source bytes
RETURN: restores exact source/constellation address with evidence-only witness
preserved_boundaries: No generated connective story is active.
No imposed canon chronology joins 2021 and 2026 strata.
No active runtime reintroduces the rejected bespoke Prison Age reader.
Later co-created strata are not silently promoted into the recovered 2021 root.
Unresolved motifs remain outside active source metadata.
Recurrence does not claim semantic equivalence.
ECHO does not claim theme, intent, causality, canon order, equivalence or comprehension.
FIELD does not author Prison Age.
proof_plan: Static Prison Age source contract verifies unchanged story fingerprints, exact 2021 root hash, recurrence boundary, single active route and three FIELD actions.
Browser constellation smoke verifies threshold/rearrangement, RIDE ROOT, authored-reader authority, exact source RETURN, 2026 movement RIDE and source re-entry.
Existing authored-reader smoke remains responsible for recurrence jump offsets, provenance and READFIELD exact return.
Existing source-ECHO tests remain responsible for hash-gated cross-source evidence.
insights: The recovered 2021 material is strongest as a proto-root / representation event, not as a default narrative chapter.
The four 2026 movements already contain strong source-level transformations; the interface should let the reader discover them rather than naming an interpretive engine.
ROOT and ECHO are deliberately unequal relations: one is within-source letter conservation, the other cross-source lexical evidence.
The correct convergence surface is one FIELD object with three native actions and deeper source-owned apertures, not another story application.

Should a later pass visualize ECHO topology across the four movements, provided every edge remains exact-source and hash-gated?
